svg.title: CDC already has a place; but can it have a place inside Kubernetes?
svg.desc: Debezium already has an official Kubernetes operator, installed via Helm and listed on OperatorHub. The open question is whether CDC can have a place in a new role: letting Kubernetes react to the behavior of the data. We tested where CDC beats cheaper sources (6 experiments).
